column1: # Game profile of DOOM (2016) (Switch, 1.4 = v262144). Plays on the Mac and the iPhone (menus, the campaign's first levels, 30 fps)
# id Tech 6 on SDK 6.4.0, NVN; Wwise audio. Its shaders are GLSLC outputs in the renderProg entries of the .resources files, found through the newest .pindex
# (shader_split.py idtech_shaders). What the host and chain needed for it: README.md
# not loaded, main takes nothing from it the host does not supply: subsdk0 (1,659 instructions, no imports the host lacks)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB − 42 MB of bss (counted as used memory): a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# id Tech 6's pre-pass geometry shader appends 16-bit index lists at 2-byte boundaries with 32-bit compare-and-swaps
# the render thread waits on its frame sync before it has fenced it once (boot stopped at "Initializing renderSystem media"): a sync never fenced counts as signaled
# used memory for the current rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB
# DOOM asks for interval 2; id Tech 6 runs at any frame rate on PC (game speed at 60 not measured here): the launcher offers 60 fps (display mode)
